# Bazuki Perfumes

> Bazuki is an India-based AI perfumery that composes personalized luxury fragrances and delivers 360° aroma marketing solutions for hospitality, retail, and corporate spaces. A 2-minute, 16-question AI quiz generates three custom scents matched to a person's personality, mood, and lifestyle, then made-to-order from an IFRA-compliant ingredient library.

## Key Facts

- Category: AI-personalized luxury perfumery + Scent Marketing
- Headquarters: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Service area: India (nationwide shipping)
- Bottle sizes: 30ml, 50ml
- 30ml custom scent: ₹700
- 3-bottle Discovery Set: ₹1,500 (₹600 saving)
- Pre-made Sampler Set: ₹499
- Currency: INR
- Delivery: made-to-order, ships in ~7 days within India
- Ingredient library: 10 IFRA-compliant fragrance notes
- AI quiz length: 16 questions, ~3 minutes
- Output: 3 personalized matches per quiz (safe favorite, adventurous twist, signature statement)
